Buprenorphine treatment maintenance throughout the perioperative period
buprenorphine treatment discontinuation before cesarean delivery
cohort: 87 pregnant women with opioid use disorder (OUD) who received prenatal buprenorphine treatment and underwent cesarean delivery
finding: There were no significant differences in perioperative opioid analgesic use or hospital length of stay between women with OUD who discontinued buprenorphine before cesarean delivery and those who continued treatment.
